title: Clinical Physician (Full-time or Part time)
description:
ABOUT OPTEXITY

Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models on data no other lab can reach. We deploy directly inside clinics and hospitals - including systems with no APIs, using integration infrastructure we've built and open-sourced - and in return become their preferred partner. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them.

We're a small, fast-moving founding team with multiple published papers in NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR and backgrounds from Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, CMU, and IIT.

We are backed by world-class investors and leaders including Jeff Dean, Neotribe VC, PearVC, Together Fund, and Zapier Fund.

HOW WE WORK

- Customer obsession - we start with the customer and work backwards

- Intellectual honesty - ideas matter more than titles; we communicate directly and assume good intent, even in disagreement

- Bias for action - we build and learn with customers rather than debate in the abstract

- Extreme ownership - we own outcomes, not just tasks, and see problems through

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We're building a clinical AI assistant that sits inside real practices - surfacing care gaps, assembling pre-visit prep, flagging risk, and suggesting treatment plans. None of that works without physicians defining what "correct" means.

Most clinical advisor roles are a monthly call where someone reacts to a demo. This one isn't. You'll be in the product loop weekly: deciding what the assistant should flag, what a good summary actually looks like at 7:50am before a 15-minute visit, and grading where the model is wrong and why. Your judgment becomes our ground truth and our evaluation standard.

We're looking for physicians across internal medicine, cardiology, oncology, and other specialties - both to go deep in your own domain and to help us understand where workflows diverge across specialties.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Define what the assistant should surface. Which care gaps matter, which risk signals are worth an interruption, and which are noise that erodes trust. Translate clinical shorthand into precise, checkable criteria.

- Shape the pre-visit summary. What belongs in it, in what order, at what length - and what a physician actually reads versus scrolls past.

- Specify clinical search. What you'd want to pull from the chart before a visit, how you'd phrase it, and what a complete answer looks like.

- Judge the AI. Review model-generated risk flags, differentials, and treatment plans against your own reasoning. Score them, explain the gap, and tell us whether a miss is dangerous or merely different.

- Build ground truth. Help us construct real-case evaluation sets and rubrics that reflect actual standard of care, not textbook answers.

- Pressure-test the product. Sit in on design decisions and tell us when something wouldn't survive contact with a real clinic day.

- Contribute to publications. We publish benchmarks and technical reports; clinical co-authorship is available and encouraged.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

- MD or DO, board-certified or board-eligible

- Currently practicing or recently practicing - active clinical context matters more than titles

- Internal medicine, cardiology, oncology, or an adjacent specialty; primary care and multi-specialty experience especially welcome

- Day-to-day fluency in an EMR (Epic, eClinicalWorks, Athena, ModMed, or similar) and an honest view of where it fails you

- Opinionated about clinical workflow, and able to explain why something is right - not just that it is

- Comfortable with ambiguity, direct feedback, and being asked "how do you actually know that?"

- Genuinely interested in AI in medicine, including its failure modes

NICE TO HAVE

- Clinical informatics training or CMIO-adjacent experience

- Experience with quality measures and value-based care programs (HEDIS, MIPS, CPT Category

title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
 
Loft Orbital is looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Lead to help scale the way we build spacecraft.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role combining technical leadership with direct Manufacturing Engineering execution. You’ll spend approximately half of your time providing technical direction, prioritizing work, and mentoring Manufacturing Engineers, while remaining deeply involved in the day-to-day engineering required to build, troubleshoot, and improve our spacecraft production processes.

You’ll work directly on the production floor and partner closely with AIT, Design Engineering, Production Planning, Supply Chain, and Quality to translate spacecraft designs into robust, repeatable manufacturing processes. From developing work instructions and tooling to resolving production issues and improving manufacturability, you’ll personally own engineering work while helping the broader team operate effectively and scale.
 
What Success Looks Like:

You’ll be successful in this role by being equally comfortable leading the team and doing the work yourself.
You’ll help Manufacturing Engineers prioritize and solve difficult problems while personally developing processes, supporting technicians, troubleshooting production issues, and driving spacecraft builds forward. Over time, your work will help turn spacecraft designs into increasingly repeatable, scalable, and production-ready manufacturing processes, enabling Loft to increase production capacity without compromising the quality and reliability required for flight hardware.

 *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
At Gradient Labs , we're building the AI customer operations platform for financial services.
Founded in 2023, we now work with some of the biggest names in banking and fintech. Our platform runs specialist agents, purpose-built for financial services, to eliminate manual work across customer support and back-office operations. Together, they give product and operations teams the visibility and control to trust every outcome.
We're a team of builders from companies like Monzo, Wise, Revolut and Google. If you're excited to tackle some of the hardest problems in AI and help shape the future of customer operations, we'd love to hear from you.
🎯 How you’ll make an impact
This is a build-and-ship role. You'll turn ambiguous customer support problems into reliable, observable AI agents that handle live conversations for real users. You'll work close to production - designing prompts and tool flows, building eval suites, shipping changes, watching what breaks, and iterating fast.

• Build and operate AI agents in production : Design, implement, and maintain agentic systems powered by LLMs - handling tool calling, multi-step reasoning, and integration with customer APIs and data sources. You'll own these systems end-to-end: reliable, observable, and auditable from day one.

• Translate business problems into agentic workflows : Take on ambiguous, open-ended problems (like "help our agent handle conversations in multiple languages") and turn them into scoped, shippable projects.

• Strong product mindset: Prioritise product thinking over pure ML technique, optimising for customer and business value rather than model performance for its own sake.

• Build robust evaluation infrastructure : Create and maintain eval suites drawn from real-world scenarios and edge cases. Go beyond vibes-based testing: structured evals measuring accuracy, safety, and latency, tied to clear business outcomes, used to drive systematic improvements to prompts, tools, and behaviour.

• Enhance our agent : Develop, evaluate, and optimise the skills that make up our agent. Curate datasets, iterate on improvements, test changes, and ship successful approaches into production.

• Shape our internal AI platform : Contribute to shared libraries, patterns, and standards for how we build, evaluate, and deploy agents across customers. Help define how we approach prompting, tool orchestration, retrieval, and monitoring.

• Experiment and prototype : Keep up with the latest in NLP, agentic systems, and generative AI. Prototype against our hardest problems with a bias toward shipping experiments quickly rather than long research cycles. Our agents already handle tens of thousands of real customer conversations every hour, so your work has immediate, visible impact.

• Analyse data : Work across customer queries, support tickets, and related data to find patterns and identify what our agents could automate next.

• Drive technical decisions : Scope your own work, push back when the framing is wrong, and tell us when the plan needs to change.

💡 What you’ll bring

• Professional software engineering experience, with a meaningful focus on Machine Learning, NLP, or applied AI. At this time, we need the ML/applied AI experience as a non-negotiable requirement for this role.

• Experience shipping products to real, live customers, not just internal tools or prototypes, ideally at meaningful scale.

• A strong product mindset - you can take a vague problem, break it down from first principles, and know how to get to a valuable first version. You have a preference for fast iteration over long research cycles.

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs, whether in a previous role, at a startup (even one that didn't work out), or on a small, scrappy team.

Centricity Research is one of North America's largest clinical research networks and a fully centralized Integrated Research Organization (IRO). We conduct Phase I-IV clinical trials across more than 35 therapeutic areas, partnering with leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to advance healthcare through innovative clinical research. Join our growing team and build a rewarding career while helping bring new treatments to patients.

About the Role

We're looking for a Financial Analyst, FP&A to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis across corporate and site-level cost centers. This remote Canada role will focus on recurring reporting, variance analysis, cash-flow management, and rolling forecasts while helping strengthen our growing FP&A function.

•
Budgeting & Forecasting: Support the annual budgeting process and periodic re-forecasts, build andmaintainrolling forecasts, and track variances to flag risks and opportunities early.

Financial Modeling: Build and continuously improve financial models supporting site performance, study/trial economics, and new business cases, and develop KPI and unit-economics tracking (cost per site, trial margin, revenue per therapeutic area).

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.

• Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.

• Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.

• Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.

• Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.

• Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.

title: Senior Product Manager - Monitoring & Research
description:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand, engage, and retain customers at scale.
Unlike traditional platforms that stop at reporting and dashboards, Lucidya combines proprietary AI, deep language understanding, and autonomous workflows to help organizations move from insight to action. Our technology is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual customer conversations, enabling brands across the MENA region to make better decisions, deliver better experiences, and build stronger customer relationships.
As AI reshapes how businesses operate, we're building products that make customer understanding faster, more accurate, and more actionable than ever before.
Why This Role Matters
Most organizations today are overwhelmed with customer data.
Conversations are happening across social media, surveys, reviews, support tickets, messaging channels, and countless other touchpoints. The challenge isn't collecting the data anymore. It's knowing what matters and what to do next.
The Monitoring & Research domain sits at the center of that challenge.
This is where customers come to understand public perception, identify emerging trends, monitor competitors, measure customer sentiment, and uncover the insights that drive business decisions. It is one of the most strategically important parts of Lucidya 's platform and one of the biggest opportunities for innovation as AI transforms how research and customer intelligence are done.
As Senior Product Manager, you'll be responsible for shaping how thousands of users discover, trust, and act on insights generated from millions of customer conversations.

About the Role

Fabstation puts AR work instructions directly onto structural steel during fabrication. Our software runs on AR tablets and headsets on real shop floors across North America, overlaying CAD-driven guidance onto multi-tonne steel assemblies during fit-up, welding, and inspection. We are cash-flow positive, growing fast, and used daily in production.

We are hiring a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to own our real-time 3D object tracking capability : locking a CAD model onto a physical steel member and keeping it locked as the user moves around it. Tracking is core to our product, and we build it in-house.

You will build on internal groundwork already underway and own the road from there: architecture, implementation, optimization, and production hardening. This is a role for someone who wants to own a hard, central problem end-to-end and see it shipped into the hands of real tradespeople, not maintain someone else's pipeline.

What You'll Do

• Own the on-device object tracking core end-to-end, from architecture through production

• Design and implement real-time, model-based 6DoF pose estimation and continuous tracking for textureless steel structures, using CAD models as the tracking reference

• Fuse object tracking with platform world tracking (visual-inertial odometry), depth, and IMU data; own tracking-loss detection, drift management, and recovery

• Optimize native C++ vision pipelines for iOS and Apple silicon: rendering, CPU/GPU budgets, and sustained frame rates on iPad or headset hardware

• Extend tracking to large structures: partial visibility, multi-region strategies, and CAD mesh preprocessing from IFC/STEP - type exports

• Integrate native modules with Unity via a plugin bridge, and work with our Unity team from prototype through release

• Shipped at least one real-time computer vision feature on a mobile platform (iOS or Android)

• Strong modern C++; Python is an asset

• Solid foundation in 3D geometry: camera models, calibration, projective geometry, and linear algebra

• Working command of nonlinear least-squares optimization (Gauss-Newton / Levenberg-Marquardt) and pose parameterization on SE(3)

• Hands-on experience with pose estimation and object tracking algorithms

• Experience integrating native C++ libraries with Unity, or equivalent native-mobile plugin experience

• Strong profiling and optimization skills on ARM (frame budgets, Instruments or equivalent)

• Working proficiency with OpenCV

Preferred Qualifications

• Model-based 3D object tracking (region-based, edge-based, or hybrid approaches)

• Metal and GPU compute on Apple silicon

• Visual-inertial odometry or SLAM; ARKit (ARCore an asset)

• State estimation and multi-sensor fusion: Kalman filtering, factor graphs (Ceres, g2o, GTSAM), extrinsic calibration, and time synchronization

• On-device ML deployment: Core ML, ONNX Runtime, or Unity Sentis; learning-based pose estimation or refinement that has shipped on-device

• CAD data handling: mesh processing and decimation, IFC/STEP-style exports

• Background in industrial vision, robotics, or augmented reality

How to Apply

We prioritize applications that demonstrate hands-on, real-time computer vision work. Please include:

• A brief introduction and a summary of relevant experience

• Links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or publications

title: Freelance ERP Program Manager Finance
description:

Programme Manager ERP Financier
Le Programme Manager ERP Financier prend en charge le pilotage global d’un programme ERP dans sa composante financière. Responsabilités principales

• Piloter le programme ERP de bout en bout : cadrage, planification, suivi budgétaire et reporting aux parties prenantes.

• Coordonner les équipes projet : experts finance, IT, intégrateurs et éditeurs, en arbitrant les priorités et les dépendances.

• Assurer la gouvernance du programme et communiquer de manière efficace avec les décideurs et les parties prenantes de niveau exécutif.

• Gérer les risques, les escalades et la continuité globale du programme.

• Veiller à la conformité des livrables avec les exigences réglementaires, le cahier des charges, les règles de marchés publics et les standards financiers applicables.

• Accompagner la transformation digitale et la conduite du changement auprès des équipes finance et de la direction.

• Garantir une bonne articulation entre l’ERP et les environnements existants, y compris lorsqu’un contexte mainframe fait partie du paysage applicatif.

• Vous disposez d’une formation de niveau Bac+5 en finance, ingénierie ou école de commerce.

• Vous maîtrisez un ERP majeur tel que SAP, Oracle ou Microsoft Dynamics.

• Vous possédez une solide expérience des business requirements, de la gouvernance programme et du pilotage de parties prenantes de niveau C-level.

• Vous avez une expertise avérée en change management, transformation digitale et coordination de programmes complexes.

• Vous avez une expérience confirmée du secteur public, idéalement dans le contexte d’une grande ville.

• Vous connaissez en profondeur la comptabilité communale belge, en particulier les processus détaillés de dépenses, recettes et budget d’une grande ville.

• Vous comprenez les enjeux de marchés publics et savez intégrer ces contraintes dans le pilotage du programme.

title: Senior Business Developer - National Security
Inside Sales Agent (ISA) — Real Estate Cold Calling
description:
Company Overview

The clients are a two-agent real estate team built around direct lead generation rather than relying on a brokerage's referral pipeline. Client 1 works primarily as a buyer's agent with a large personal sphere of influence, while Client 2 focuses on the listing side and maintains his own book of clients in Follow Up Boss. The team invests directly in leads - including tax record data, expired and withdrawn listings, for-sale-by-owner leads, and open house leads - so they can keep more of what they earn on each deal instead of splitting it with a brokerage.

Role Overview

Client 1 is running lead generation and client-facing transactions largely on his own and doesn't have the bandwidth to consistently work the volume of leads coming in. This role is an Inside Sales Agent (ISA) whose sole purpose is the investment side of the business: working through roughly 840-850 existing leads sitting dormant in the team's CRM, following up on batch-purchased leads (expired, withdrawn, FSBO) and open house leads, and keeping people warm until they're ready to meet.

The ISA will also spend time in Client 2's Follow Up Boss account, which holds a number of warm leads that go untouched while he's out on showings and listing appointments. Success in this role means booking qualified appointments - in person or by phone - where Client 1 or Client 2 can take over the conversation.

Key Responsibilities

• Make outbound calls to existing and newly purchased leads (old database leads, expired/withdrawn listings, FSBO leads, and open house leads) to re-engage and qualify them.

• Follow up consistently with leads over time to keep them warm until they're ready to transact.

• Gather buyer criteria on qualifying calls - target areas, price range, home style, bed/bath count, must-have amenities (e.g., proximity to a train station), and timeline.

• Book appointments or phone consultations for Client 1 (and occasionally Client 2) with qualified leads, and confirm they show up.

• Work leads inside the team's CRMs (HighLevel and Follow Up Boss) - logging call outcomes and moving leads through the pipeline.

• Spend part of the time managing and following up on warm leads already sitting in Client 2's Follow Up Boss account.

• Aim for a high volume of outbound activity - target is roughly 125-150+ calls per shift, working toward ~900 calls per week.

Skills & Tools

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience specifically in real estate cold calling / ISA work - general call center, pharmaceutical, or other consumer sales experience does not meet this requirement.

• Comfortable working in CRMs such as HighLevel and Follow Up Boss (training available, but prior CRM fluency is a plus).

• Strong phone presence - confident, personable, and persistent without being pushy.

• Well organized and consistent with follow-up; able to manage a high volume of leads without letting any go cold.

• Able to gather and accurately record buyer criteria and lead details.

• Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable working independently once given a lead list.

title: Research Intern, Frontier Agents (Winter 2027)

The Agents team investigates how to build, align, and scale frontier AI systems that can tackle complex, multi-step tasks and workflows across text and speech, with a particular focus on agentic and scientific domains. Our work sits at the intersection of agent capabilities, human-computer interaction, and infrastructure-from designing post-training methods for agentic behavior to developing evaluation frameworks for open-ended tasks where traditional metrics fall short. 

As a research intern, you will work on problems at the frontier of agentic AI, where challenges in alignment, reliability, and scalability are deeply intertwined. Projects may involve developing new training recipes for self-learning and long-horizon reasoning, curating datasets for non-deterministic scientific and agentic tasks, studying failure modes in agentic behavior, or building infrastructure that enables agent operations at scale. You'll operate in a space where algorithmic innovation, dataset and interaction design, and systems work come together to push the boundaries of what AI agents can reliably accomplish.

description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.

Together for Girls works around the world and combines state-of-the-art data with powerful advocacy to end violence against children and adolescents, especially sexual violence. Through data and advocacy, TfG drives action to break cycles of violence and ensure prevention, healing, and justice. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world. About the Role A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem. We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out. The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't. Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Role Overview

Role:

We are looking for a Senior Staff Quantum Scientist to join our Science team at IonQ. In this role, you will take a leading role in our research efforts, driving experimental efforts and the architecture of our future generation quantum systems.

We are pioneering advancements in quantum computing by utilising trapped ion technology and our proprietary laser-free quantum control methods. Our research and development efforts build on our fully integrated quantum processors that can be fabricated within standard silicon foundries. This unique approach allows us to leverage the highest-performing qubit technology while ensuring scalability and manufacturability using existing semiconductor fabrication technology.

• Detect inconsistencies, ambiguities, or factual inaccuracies in digital content.

• Document findings and insights meticulously in online review platforms.

• Collaborate asynchronously with project managers and reviewers to ensure consistent evaluation standards.

• Work independently while managing deliverables and deadlines per project requirements.

• English as a first language or fully equivalent written fluency.

• Qualifying law degree from a university in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, or New Zealand.

• Demonstrated experience drafting briefs, motions, memoranda, legal opinions, or regulatory submissions.

• Background in reviewing, editing, or supervising legal writing by junior lawyers, trainees, or paralegals.
